receipt.local.text: Nothing left this device to write this answer. Your browser’s own record shows it.
receipt.inCloud.text: Your conversation was sent to the cloud to write this answer.
receipt.unknown.text: Your browser didn’t keep its record of what was sent while this answer was written.
receipt.save.text: How this answer was made, not what was said. Safe to share.
receipt.proof.text: The certificate, plus your request and the answer.
receipt.log: Record them in a public log, {host}: public and permanent
receipt.witnesses.text: Certificates go to these addresses only when you choose so in About this answer, never what was said. Leave them empty for the usual ones; to name several who date them, separate them with spaces.
receipt.places.text: Certificates name the country you give for each brain in the cloud.
receipt.spentLede: Worked out from what each answer's brains read and wrote, at their prices today, as under each answer.
receipt.certificatesText: This device’s seal, who dates certificates, and the public log
receipt.seal.text: Certificates saved here are sealed with a key that never leaves this device. Whoever relies on them can check this fingerprint, or agree on it with you beforehand.
